speaker: generic_agent
content: The business goal is to maximize total profit from producing three tabletop golf toy types. The only decisions are how many units of each toy type to produce. Constraints are: total manufacturing labor hours across all toys must not exceed 1000; total inspection hours across all toys must not exceed 500; and production quantities must not exceed the market demand caps of 50 high-end, 80 mid-range, and 150 low-end units. No minimum production requirements apply, and any toy type may be produced at zero units. Per-unit labor, inspection, and profit values are given. Remaining minor assumption: production quantities are treated as whole units, which is standard for discrete toys but was not explicitly confirmed.
